request.query: cardinality filtered Cartesian product equals sum of cardinalities of sections arbitrary predicate

items.name: Fintype.card_filter_piFinset_eq_of_mem
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_4} {α : ι → Type u_6} [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : (i : ι) → DecidableEq (α i)]
  (s : (i : ι) → Finset (α i)) (i : ι) {a : α i},
  a ∈ s i → {f ∈ Fintype.piFinset s | f i = a}.card = ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (s j).card

items.name: Cardinal.mk_setProd
items.type: ∀ {α β : Type u} (s : Set α) (t : Set β), Cardinal.mk ↑(s ×ˢ t) = Cardinal.mk ↑s * Cardinal.mk ↑t

items.name: Fintype.card_filter_piFinset_eq
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_4} {α : ι → Type u_6} [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : (i : ι) → DecidableEq (α i)]
  (s : (i : ι) → Finset (α i)) (i : ι) (a : α i),
  {f ∈ Fintype.piFinset s | f i = a}.card = if a ∈ s i then ∏ b ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (s b).card else 0

items.name: Nat.card_pi
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : α → Type u_3} [inst : Fintype α], Nat.card ((a : α) → β a) = ∏ a, Nat.card (β a)

items.name: Finset.card_pi
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_4} {α : ι → Type u_6} [inst : DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (t : (i : ι) → Finset (α i)),
  (s.pi t).card = ∏ i ∈ s, (t i).card
